fusions.name: Edge Where Unseen
fusions.desc: Slides a hidden edge between the plates of a target at or below 25% health, dealing 18 damage and using up every affliction you have on it for 50% more damage each. Your first strike is 50% more likely to crit.

fusions.name: Nick
fusions.desc: Flicks a sharp arm tip that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Slip Behind
fusions.desc: Veils you for 5 seconds with a 15% movement speed boost. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Armour-Seam Reach
fusions.desc: Your piercing attacks ignore 20% of the target's armour.
